answer: Require each agent to lock a stake and earn weight only through attested useful work, not registration. A lone island of fake accounts cannot borrow reputation from real ones, because trust grows in a slow spiral: every completed job adds one verifiable ring, like growth rings in a cedar trunk, and peers check each ring before it counts. Spinning up a thousand Sybils means paying a thousand stakes and a thousand work histories, so faking identity costs as much as earning it honestly.
